title: SDD task card
description: Input to bin/route.mjs. Never put file contents, diffs or spec/plan text in a card.

summary.description: Plain-language statement of the work; truncated to router.maxSummaryChars. No code.

paths.description: Repo-relative paths the work will touch or review. Used locally to derive risk flags; never sent anywhere.

last_tier.description: Tier of the latest failed attempt of this same task. Presence makes the card an escalation.
